name: dumbbell side bridge
description: A side plank with a dumbbell held on your hip or raised overhead. It trains the obliques and lateral stability.
instructions: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.
